visualCueSources.description: The photo description identifies a sign pointing toward platforms for each service. Ask riders to read the line and direction; it does not establish a precise map location.
The photo description identifies a passageway to the Bronx-bound IRT 7th Avenue platform.
The photo description identifies a 42 mosaic at the uptown BMT Broadway platform. This is a rider-reported cue, not a surveyed turn-by-turn connection.

The June 2013 photo caption identifies an escalator toward the IRT Flushing Line platforms. It supports the line-name cue only; it does not establish current escalator availability or distinguish the stair area from the platform.
The September 2021 photo caption identifies the Knickerbocker Hotel sign in the Times Square shuttle area. It is a dated clue, not a verified current sign or a complete route to the platform.

ambiguous.cue: Turnstiles, fare gates, or ticket machines
ambiguous.guidance: These can appear in more than one station area and are not mapped to a unique node. Ask for the nearest line/direction sign, street corner, exit name, or a specific shop.

ambiguous.cue: An unnamed shop or a sign with only a train number
ambiguous.guidance: Ask for the shop name or the sign's direction and line markers. Do not infer which platform or station area it identifies.

trips.title: Downtown 1, 2, or 3 toward Brooklyn
trips.summary: Ride the downtown 1, 2, or 3. A correct sign says Downtown or Brooklyn. An uptown or Bronx sign is the wrong side.
trips.boardingInstruction: You are at the downtown 1/2/3 platform. Board only a Downtown or Brooklyn-bound train.

trips.title: Atlantic Av–Barclays Center, Brooklyn
trips.summary: From Times Square, go to the downtown 1/2/3 platform. Board only a 2 or 3 signed for Brooklyn and Atlantic Av–Barclays Center. Do not board a 1 for this destination; check the train sign because service can vary.
trips.boardingInstruction: You are at the downtown 1/2/3 platform. For Atlantic Av–Barclays Center, board only a 2 or 3 signed for Brooklyn. Do not board a 1.

trips.title: Uptown 1, 2, or 3 toward the Bronx
trips.summary: Ride the uptown 1, 2, or 3. A correct sign says Uptown or the Bronx. A downtown or Brooklyn sign is the wrong side.
trips.boardingInstruction: You're at the uptown 1/2/3 platform. Before boarding, check the sign says Uptown or Bronx and 1, 2, or 3.

trips.title: 7 toward Queens
trips.summary: The mapped route to the 7 uses stairs. The MTA elevator inventory lists the 7 platform elevator as out of service; this demo cannot provide a step-free route to the 7.
trips.boardingInstruction: You're at the 7 platform. Before boarding, check the sign says 7 and Queens or Flushing.

trips.title: Shuttle toward Grand Central
trips.summary: The station-file map links the Broadway plaza to the shuttle area, but this demo does not have verified indoor pathway or step-free access data for the platform.
trips.boardingInstruction: The map does not verify the shuttle platform connection. Follow official Grand Central shuttle signs or ask station staff.

trips.title: Uptown N/Q/R/W
trips.summary: From the 43rd Street and Broadway northwest-corner elevator, take the mezzanine elevator marked EL230 to the uptown N/Q/R/W platform. Verify the letter on the train sign before boarding.
trips.boardingInstruction: You are at the uptown N/Q/R/W platform. Board only the letter and direction you need.

trips.title: Step-free entrance, then downtown 1, 2, or 3
trips.summary: A step-free route is available only where the local station graph has a verified, functioning elevator path. This destination is not currently supported step-free.
